what_to_detect: A combat in which a creature with poisonous deals combat damage to a player, so its poisonous trigger gives that player poison counters.
near_miss: A combat in which the creature with poisonous deals no combat damage to a player, or a damage-step probe of the combat with poisonous stripped.
record_fields: combat record damage_dealt events to a player with the carrier as source
poison_change event of the poisonous trigger's resolution
